description: This file is a shell script source library for performance testing in a Git project. It provides functions to set up repositories, run performance tests, and handle test environments, specifically tailored for performance benchmarking and related utilities.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a specified performance test script with optional prerequisites and setup steps, repeating the measurement as configured.

methods.name: test_size
methods.description: Executes a size measurement test with optional prerequisites and setup steps.

methods.name: test_wrapper_
methods.description: Wraps test execution with setup for prerequisites, environment, and result handling.

methods.name: test_run_perf_
methods.description: Handles the core execution of performance timing using GNU time, environment setup, and result collection.

methods.name: die_if_build_dir_not_repo
methods.description: Checks if the build directory is a Git repository; exits if not.
